label: HISTORICAL REPLAY — complete-vs-extend mismatch forensic. Not shadow, not submitted, not filled, not settled, not realized profit for our account.
scorecard_feature_leak: score.build_rows passes nxt['seconds_to_settlement'] into am.state_key, so the model's TTE bucket is the time-to-expiry of the fill it is predicting rather than the time-to-expiry at the decision instant. Within a 15m window the two differ by exactly the inter-fill gap, whose median is under 2s, so the practical leak is small -- but it is a leak in the MODEL's favour, which means the model's measured exposure-action accuracy (0.6845) is an upper bound. The forensic characterisation below uses `tte_at_decision` (prev row's own TTE) instead, and reports the model's `state` only as a lookup identifier.

labelling_verification.verdict: LABELLING SOUND for the complete/extend distinction: every row `_relation` calls `complete` is a buy on the deficit side and every `extend` is a buy on the surplus side, and the tape's own residual column moves in the matching direction except where a `complete` clip is larger than the standing residual and overshoots through zero (still a reduction toward flat, then past it). The scorecard's 3,536-row cohort is therefore the right cohort and its economic bracket is not invalidated.

state_key_degeneracy.note: am.IMBALANCE_BUCKETS = (flat, imb1-10, imb10-50, imb>50). The top bucket is OPEN-ENDED above 50 shares, and the holdout's median standing imbalance is 140.1 shares, so the model's only inventory feature is saturated on the overwhelming majority of the very decisions it exists to make.

calibration.verdict: The model's own P(complete) is only weakly separating, and EVERY threshold that recovers mismatches breaks MORE correct extends than it recovers (net rows negative at 0.30/0.35/0.40/0.45). The turn is therefore NOT merely suppressed by the argmax rule — it is not in the model's state at all. Recalibration cannot fix this; only a new observable can.

conclusion.headline: The 3,536-row mismatch IS L5's TURN. Conditioned on prev_rel == 'extend' the mismatch rate is 0.943 and 2,976 rows (84.2%) / $37,449 of $44,787 notional sit in that one cell. No contemporaneously observable state variable in the repo moves the rate off ~0.9 once the previous action is fixed.
conclusion.mechanism: L5's `complete` is an ARRIVAL, not a decision: a standing complement bid being hit when the other token's quote crosses it. That event lives in the ORDER BOOK, not in the fill history, so it has no state signature on this corpus.
falsified_explanations: standing imbalance drives it — AUC 0.488 vs correct extends, mismatch rate 0.29-0.42 flat across 10..800 shares
completion cost headroom drives it — degenerate, 98.5% of complete decisions sit at headroom >= 0.15
the turn is merely suppressed by argmax — every P(complete) threshold breaks more correct extends than it recovers
conclusion.second_defect: am.IMBALANCE_BUCKETS saturates above 50 shares against a 140.1-share median standing imbalance; 78.6% of test rows and 7,989 of 10,035 complete decisions fall in one bucket, so the state key carries almost no inventory information. Fixable without new data; §2.2 says insufficient on its own.
conclusion.scorecard_bug: NONE in the complete/extend labelling — verified independently against the tape's own residual column. The bracket stands. A separate TTE FEATURE LEAK is reported (see scorecard_feature_leak).
conclusion.believed_bracket_end: LOWER (~-$1,300..-$3,000 over two days, -$2..-$5/window): the error self-heals within the window because post-complete prediction is 94% correct, so the settlement-time -$0.1832/share rate is the wrong multiplier for a transient.

undecidable.price_relative_to_touch: UNSCORABLE. No contemporaneous top-of-book over L5's windows (analysis/l5/L5_TOUCH_PROXIMITY.md §0). We cannot tell whether L5 completed because the complement came to HIM at a price he had resting, or because he crossed for it. MISSING ARTIFACT: a per-second top-of-book (both outcome tokens) series covering the canonical sequence's own windows — the only L2 on disk (Zenodo 22084977, 2026-08-21..24) overlaps ZERO canonical windows.
undecidable.orders_and_cancels: UNAVAILABLE. The corpus is a FILL tape. A resting complement bid that was not hit is indistinguishable from a decision not to complete, so PASSIVE completion and ACTIVE completion cannot be separated at all. MISSING ARTIFACT: L5 order placement/cancel events, which the venue does not serve.
undecidable.consequence: If L5's complete/extend choice is driven by which side of the book was quotable at that instant, then NO function of the fill tape can reproduce it, and the 35.2% mismatch is an IRREDUCIBLE floor on this data rather than a modelling defect. The two artifacts above are what would decide it.
